plainName: Carrying forward a loss from house property
summary: A house-property loss not set off in the year it arose is carried to later years and set only against income from house property, for a limited number of years, after which it lapses. A return filed late does not lose it.

routes.name: The carried loss against later house-property income
routes.description: The oldest year's loss is used first; the order is stated, because the law does not fix one.

routes.name: The part that arose from own-home interest
routes.description: It is used like the rest of the loss in the old regime.

disqualifiers.description: In the default regime, the part of a carried loss that arose from a deduction that regime does not allow is not used, and it is treated as fully used.
